configuration.cost: distance to goal plus terminal distance

scope: Two-update success regression with its own curriculum; not the first two updates of the 5000-update experiment or a paper reproduction.
regression_before: The second-step NaN batch reached boat:Training / Nonfinite training loss.; no training-failure.mat was saved, so the new loss regression failed.
regression_after: All three controlled second-step failures retain the exact first completed network, two finite nonempty Adam moments, one-row history, RNG states, fixed validation inputs and failed batch; the original failure propagates.

failure_fixtures.injection: Second batch S(2,1)=NaN before the real loss evaluation.
Second returned gradient Value{1}(1)=NaN; finite real loss.
Second gradient Value{1}(1)=1e200; finite gradient overflows the real Adam second moment.

fixture_scope: Temporary instrumented demo copies with distinct entry names; actual boat_loss and adamupdate execute. No production fault hooks. These are controlled failures, not observed failures of default training.
preservation_scope: Checks after loss/gradient return and the Adam update. Save failureState in training-failure.mat and rethrow the original error; secondary save errors are attached as causes. No automatic resume or periodic checkpoints.
scientific_scope: Numerical finiteness is not heldout acceptance, convergence or safety. Historical experiments are unchanged.
